name: Cremora tart
summary: A retro no-bake fridge tart: creamer powder whipped with condensed milk and lemon juice into a tangy, mousse-like filling in a biscuit crust.
about: Cremora tart is named after the coffee creamer it is made with, a South African pantry staple since the 1960s. The no-bake tart spread through community and school-bazaar recipe books and is now a retro classic.

ingredients.name: Non-dairy creamer powder
ingredients.note: coffee creamer; it contains milk protein

steps: Mix the biscuit crumbs with the melted butter. Keep back 2 tbsp of crumbs and press the rest firmly over the base and sides of a 23 cm pie dish. Chill for 20 minutes, until firm.
Beat the creamer powder with the boiling water using an electric mixer for 1–2 minutes, until smooth with no lumps. Refrigerate for 30 minutes, until completely cold.
Beat the condensed milk while adding the lemon juice in a thin stream; it will thicken as you go.
Add the cold creamer mixture and beat on high for 10–15 minutes, until thick, pale and holding soft peaks.
Spread the filling into the crust, sprinkle over the reserved crumbs and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, or overnight, until set.
Slice with a knife dipped in hot water and serve cold.
prepNote: Make it the day before; it keeps 3 days in the fridge.
